notes.title: The First Trailer for BloodSworn Has Been Released!
notes.notes:
Following several months of development, the game has now advanced to a stage where we're excited to present a glimpse of its atmosphere and gameplay through a trailer! The current iteration is best described as an alpha version, and given its nature as a cooperative roguelite game, significant changes may still occur throughout the development process.

[previewyoutube=wQWS7XeRTqg;full][/previewyoutube]

At the moment, our primary focus is on integrating essential elements into the game, like character progression utilizing the blood collected from defeated enemies. Our goal is to establish a captivating and intuitive system that keeps players engaged for extended periods while allowing for the creation of diverse character builds. Additionally, we're introducing a simple mission system to enhance replayability, offering a wide array of unlockable items and abilities. We're committed to integrating a variety of interesting tasks into the game to ensure that returning to it remains rewarding.

So, this summarizes our current development stage. It's safe to say that the core of the game is already established, and refining it will heavily depend on feedback from players!

That's all for today, folks! Enjoy the trailer, and we'll see you next time! In the meantime, let's get back to working on the game!

[h3]And don't forget to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b], as well as follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/DeppreSickTeam]Twitter[/url]! If you want to chat with us about the development or about our previous games, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/JJbShh63YC]join our Discord server[/url]![/h3]

notes.title: Brief description of the game and an announcement!
notes.notes:
Welcome to all dear horror enthusiasts! 

I hope everyone is feeling well and ready for a new adventure! This time, we've decided to take a break from the survival horror category and plunge into a similarly bloody but much more action-packed game! This game will be a cooperative roguelite FPS, where players will fight against an evil cult, using firearms, blood magic and various relics with magical properties. Furthermore, players can enhance themselves with the blood of slain cult members, gradually becoming stronger and better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623705/5a8a87f10dc222558eb313e01878826a967b6963.png[/img]
In the final version, you will be able to play with three of your friends, and a forest camp will be the lobby of the game where you can check missions and select your character. Each character will initially have a unique active ability, which can later be expanded with passive abilities.

Our goal is to create an entertaining, fast-paced, and blood soaked FPS that includes enough randomization and unlockable content to make the game enjoyable for a long time. The difficulty level can be increased on the way, and we design the levels to be easily expandable. A slightly more distant plan is to provide solo players with an NPC companion that they can customize according to their preferences. So, if you happen to be in a tight spot or your health is low, there will be someone to help you out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623705/127fec39314a543fb5f1e202d6d2ecea00a459fd.png[/img]
As the development is past a well-functioning vertical slice version, [b]a trailer for the game is coming soon![/b] So get ready because blood will be spilled, a lot of blood!

I would like to thank everyone who helps with the development, be it with a comment, a share or spreading a word for us, it means a lot to our tiny team! 

[h3]And don't forget to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b], as well as follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/DeppreSickTeam]Twitter[/url]! If you want to chat with us about the development or about our previous games, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/JJbShh63YC]join our Discord server[/url]![/h3]
